statement:
The access record gives **open**, but this conflicts with the participants’ consent to **access on request only**.

I haven’t published the deposit. Please have the access record corrected to **restricted** before publication.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's "open" access right "conflicts with the participants’ consent to access on request only" and gives the correct value "restricted."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
